name: fix103_shrine_use
verifies: fix-103 (owner: locked inside a Beliar shrine by the approach): the use spot of a shrine lies outside the shrine's collision (the 0.9 m spot in front of its bounds centre was inside the slab: the walk stuck, gave up and teleported the hero into it); from the front and from behind the hero walks round to a free spot, kneels, the shrine's dialog opens, and after it he stands free with the controls released; the secondary button cancels the approach
steps: safe; god; notips; time 12; autodialog off
notes: useprobe clear=1 fails when the hero's capsule (above step height) overlaps a world collider or no free use spot was found; it logs how far the spot was moved out of the object (spot moved) and the push-out when the use ended. A refused shrine (the hero's god opposed) fails at 'expect dialog'. The secondary-button cancel of the approach is covered by fix75_chest_approach. Owner workaround in a demo/dev build when stuck: F10, getup; tp hero. fix-105 (r40): autodialog off — with it on the runner answered the shrine dialog to its end inside 'use' (and learnt spells), so 'expect dialog' after useprobe found it closed; now the dialog stays open until 'abort'. 'safe' before the Innos part ends any fight the hero picked up (r40: refused, in combat).
